description: Controls which generated pages should be treated as indexable. The goal is to keep the public site useful while sending Google a smaller, stronger canonical URL set.

noindexToolSlugs.reason: General insurance, pay-admin, and bill-splitting calculators sit outside the tax, real estate, and wealth-building topics this site is trying to rank for. They are kept live for existing users but removed from the index so the crawl budget goes to on-topic pages. Exception: claim-out-of-pocket-cost and money-calendar were re-indexed on 2026-09-17 because Search Console flagged them as "Excluded by noindex tag"; both now carry a methodology section and FAQ and are listed again on the tools hub and their category pages.
